title: First National Communication to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
organization: Republic of Equatorial Guinea, Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Forests and Environment
temporal_coverage: National climate and institutional assessment published in 2019; some baselines cite the 2013 adaptation plan.
methodology: National climate communication with sector analyses and proposed adaptation priorities.
limitations: Institutional conditions and proposals are historical; manager-level water conflict is not armed conflict.

title: Contribuciones Determinadas a Nivel Nacional (CDN), actualización 2022
organization: Republic of Equatorial Guinea, Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Forests and Environment
temporal_coverage: 2022 update; vulnerability passages draw partly on 2013 and 2016 evidence; targets extend to 2050.
methodology: Government NDC using climate-station trends and prior national assessments.
limitations: Superseded by the NDC 3.0 registered in October 2026; cited station series are sparse and older.

title: SCALA Equatorial Guinea
organization: United Nations Development Programme and Food and Agriculture Organization
temporal_coverage: The page reports government engagement and meetings in September–October 2023; other project statistics are undated.
methodology: UNDP project page describing national programme engagement and intended support.
limitations: The page also contains stale NAP-status text; only dated 2023 activities are used.

title: Equatorial Guinea Economic Update 2024: Designing Fiscal Instruments for Sustainable Forestry
temporal_coverage: Second edition published June 2024; forestry status and institutional review are reported for that edition.
methodology: Economic update combining forestry-sector review and fiscal-policy analysis.
limitations: Recommended reforms are proposals, not evaluated adaptation outcomes.
